policy.sourceAuthority: Synthetic host-authored records only. Authority and strictly increasing supersession order are supplied metadata, not model judgments.
policy.candidateConstruction: Manually annotated whole-field spans paired with every requested item in source order, then item order. All arms may admit only supplied eligible candidates; no other field extraction, even when source prose could support it. No gold filtering.
policy.eligibility: Exclude any record explicitly superseded by a later host record. For title candidates require exact equality with the locked requested display title. Both arms apply the identical policy.
policy.exactGrammar: Audiobook <JSON string of displayTitle>: <title|narrator> = <JSON string of field value>. Entire source statement must equal this byte-for-byte.
policy.semanticTask: Does the whole source statement establish that this named audiobook has this field value? Directed source attribution only; supported, contradicted, uncertain. No world knowledge, inferred missing metadata, or name substitution.
policy.admission: Only supported admits a semantic candidate. Contradicted and uncertain preserve missingness. Neither model confidence nor edge scores are proof probabilities.
policy.outcome: Same pure recommendation program and renderer after admission: complete title+narrator recommends; incomplete optional omits; incomplete requested is unknown; distinct admitted values conflict.
policy.limits: No source clipping or candidate truncation. Every input/field/call overflow fails the protocol.
policy.design: 8 direct controls, 6 paraphrase controls, 6 adversarial controls. Controlled mechanism evidence only, not representative memory or BEAM quality.
policy.goldIsolation: V5_GOLD is not nested in buildFixtures output and must not be read during candidate/request construction.
policy.goldComparison: For recommended items compare status, exact title and exact narrator. For unknown/omitted-incomplete compare status only; retained partial fields do not affect outcome equality. Binding admissions are scored separately. No fixture expects a conflict.

gold.mechanism: Complete canonical record: positive usefulness control.
Two complete items; cross-item candidate bindings must be rejected.
Optional incomplete item omitted without losing complete item.
Specifically requested incomplete item explicitly unknown.
Requested display title is identity, not automatic title evidence.
Same narrator can legitimately describe different items; do not impose uniqueness across items.
Preserve signs, percentages, Unicode and exact identities.
Host supersession removes stale canonical attribution for both arms.
Passive narration attribution.
Reordered narrator subject.
Narration performed by names the same role.
Title evidence and narrator evidence both noncanonical.
Host supersession plus noncanonical corrected attribution.
Canonical and paraphrase items together; recover one without contaminating the other.
One narrator belongs only to the other item; reject swapped-entity premise.
Proposed narrator is actually in the source's title position; roles reversed.
Explicit negation does not establish positive narration.
Withdrawn source is excluded; unknown current narrator cannot be filled from stale evidence.
Near titles differ by minus sign or percent; punctuation is semantic identity.
All-unknown negative control: reviewing/owning a book does not establish narration.
